title: While main is red, the base repair gets the trial slot before older ordinary items
description: Runs the real merge writer cycle with a base failure standing on main: the filed base repair is trialled while an ordinary item queued earlier, which touches what the failing test reads, starts no trial; the ordinary item is trialled once main is green (GY-3563).

steps.name: the base repair is trialled first; the earlier ordinary item waits for a green main
